label: Equilibrium surface tension
definition: Equilibrium tension of a liquid-gas interface.

label: Dynamic surface tension
definition: Surface tension at a defined surface age after interface creation.

label: Equilibrium interfacial tension
definition: Equilibrium tension between two distinct liquid phases.

label: Dynamic interfacial tension
definition: Liquid-liquid interfacial tension at a defined surface age.

label: Static contact angle
definition: Apparent static contact angle measured through the explicitly identified phase.

label: Advancing contact angle
definition: Apparent advancing contact angle measured through the explicitly identified phase.

label: Receding contact angle
definition: Apparent receding contact angle measured through the explicitly identified phase.

label: Equilibrium adsorption loading
definition: Directly observed equilibrium mass of an identified adsorbate per dry sorbent mass at a stated equilibrium fluid concentration; fitted capacity and area-normalized excess are different terms.

label: Deprecated dynamic adsorption retention
definition: Deprecated mechanism-ambiguous legacy term; use porous_media_retained_mass_dynamic unless adsorption is independently demonstrated.
model_ready_block_reason: Deprecated mechanism-ambiguous ID; migrate to porous_media_retained_mass_dynamic.

label: Interfacial layer thickness
definition: Thickness of an operationally defined interfacial or adsorbed layer.

label: Dispersion stability index
definition: Method-defined dimensionless stability index; values are comparable only for compatible protocols.
model_ready_block_reason: Generic protocol-dependent measurand is not commensurate across methods; use a specific property term.

label: Zeta potential
definition: Electrokinetic zeta potential of a specified dispersion and medium.

label: Apparent aggregate size
definition: Method-dependent apparent size of aggregates or agglomerates in a specified dispersion.
model_ready_block_reason: Generic protocol-dependent measurand is not commensurate across methods; use a specific property term.

label: Apparent viscosity
definition: Bulk apparent dynamic viscosity at a defined shear rate.

label: Plastic viscosity
definition: Plastic viscosity obtained from a stated rheological model or standard.

label: Generic yield point
definition: Legacy generic rheological yield measure; retained for staging/curation but not commensurate enough for model-ready data.
model_ready_block_reason: Generic protocol-dependent measurand is not commensurate across methods; use a specific property term.

label: Gel strength
definition: Gel strength after a defined rest time and protocol.

label: HPHT filtrate volume
definition: Cumulative filtrate volume in a defined HPHT filtration test.

label: Filter cake thickness
definition: Thickness of a filter cake after a defined filtration protocol.

label: Lubricity coefficient
definition: Dimensionless coefficient from a stated lubricity geometry and protocol.

label: Permeability impairment
definition: Fractional loss (k_before - k_after) / k_before; negative values denote improvement.

label: Recovery factor
definition: Recovered target fluid divided by the explicitly stated initial or residual in-place basis.

label: BET specific surface area
definition: Specific surface area determined by a stated BET protocol.

label: Raman ID to IG ratio
definition: Raman D-band to G-band intensity ratio at a stated excitation wavelength and fitting convention.

label: CNT outer diameter
definition: Outer-diameter statistic of a CNT population with the statistic and characterization method reported.

label: CNT length
definition: Length statistic of a CNT population with the statistic and characterization method reported.

label: Porous-media retained mass
definition: Net mass of an identified material retained per dry porous-medium mass during a stated transport experiment, without assigning adsorption, deposition, straining or plugging mechanism.

label: Sedimentation supernatant mass fraction
definition: Mass fraction of an identified initially dispersed component remaining in a defined supernatant region after gravitational storage for the stated time.

label: Centrifugation supernatant mass fraction
definition: Mass fraction of an identified initially dispersed component remaining in the operationally defined supernatant after stated relative centrifugal force and duration.

label: DLS hydrodynamic z-average diameter
definition: ISO cumulants z-average hydrodynamic diameter reported by dynamic light scattering for the specified dispersion.

label: Image-derived aggregate equivalent diameter
definition: Equivalent-circle diameter of segmented CNT aggregates or agglomerates under a stated imaging and segmentation protocol.

label: Interfacial coverage fraction
definition: Projected fraction of an explicitly identified liquid-liquid interface classified as covered by the identified material under a stated segmentation rule.

label: Emulsion Sauter mean droplet diameter
definition: Surface-area-weighted Sauter mean diameter D[3,2] of an emulsion droplet population.

label: Emulsion separated volume fraction
definition: Macroscopic separated-phase volume divided by initial emulsion sample volume after the stated storage time.

label: Oscillatory storage modulus
definition: Linear-viscoelastic storage modulus G prime at the stated angular frequency or frequency and strain amplitude.

label: Oscillatory loss modulus
definition: Linear-viscoelastic loss modulus G double prime at the stated angular frequency or frequency and strain amplitude.

label: Herschel-Bulkley yield stress
definition: Yield-stress parameter from a stated Herschel-Bulkley fit and fit domain.

label: Oilfield yield point
definition: Oilfield yield point calculated from viscometer readings under an identified API or equivalent standard and converted to pascals.

label: CNT purity mass fraction
definition: Assay-defined CNT fraction of the as-received nanomaterial sample by mass.

label: CNT ash mass fraction
definition: Residual ash mass fraction of a dry nanomaterial sample under the stated thermal protocol.

label: CNT surface oxygen atomic fraction
definition: XPS-derived oxygen atomic fraction among all quantified surface atoms under the stated quantification protocol.

label: CNT functional-group amount
definition: Amount of an explicitly identified surface functional group per dry nanotube mass under a stated assay.

label: CNT aspect ratio
definition: Population statistic of CNT length divided by outer diameter, with pairing and weighting convention reported.
